newsitem.title: USA: Kodak unit sets higher micrographics prices.
newsitem.headline: Kodak unit sets higher micrographics prices.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co's Business Imaging Systems unit said Friday it was raising its selling prices on micrographics and compact disk supplies.
Among the products affected are microfilm, duplicating film, microfilm chemistry and writable CD media.
The increases -- which range from 2 percent to 5 percent -- take effect with orders received in the U.S. after January 1, the company said.
Kodak said the increases were the result of higher distribution and raw material costs.
